Finance - Payment Settings - Setting Up a Payment Gateway

Modified on: Tue, 4 Jun, 2024 at 11:20 AM

Supported gateways include Stripe, PayPal Standard, 2Checkout, Authorize.net, PayPal PayFlow Pro, PayFast, Razorpay and Eway.

Add a gateway

  1. Create an account with a supported gateway.
  2. Navigate to Finance » Payment Settings and choose the gateway in the Add New Payment Gateway drop-down.
  3. Enter the credentials. The gateway uses the Website Currency from Settings » General Settings » Localization.
  4. Make the gateway Active and complete a test transaction.

Switching gateways

Activating a new gateway does not move active subscriptions to it. Billing information does not carry over when switching to or from Stripe.
